title: Discounted
summary: DISCOUNTED, participle passive 1. Deducted from a principal sum; paid back; refunded or allowed; as, the sum of five per cent was discounted 2. Having the amount lent on discount or deduction of a sum

inlines.v: DISCOUNTED, participle passive 1. Deducted from a principal sum; paid back; refunded or allowed; as, the sum of five per cent was discounted 2. Having the amount lent on discount or deduction of a sum in advance; as, the bill was discounted for sixty days.
